description: Bare `spendbar` = first-run wizard ("install it, run it"): instant today-$ (~1–2 s on clone path) → durable-service handoff note → auto-detected consent prompts (service + login item; claude mcp add if `claude` on PATH; codex mcp add if ~/.codex exists); --yes for scripters; re-runnable as `setup`. `doctor`: launcher/plist health, node path, snapshot freshness, MCP registration against real client launches, permission-denied explanations — prints the fix for each. `uninstall`: fingerprints recorded at install, external entries removed only on match, prompt on divergence, separate --purge-data with dry-run. Interim (already true in v0.1–0.2): bare spendbar prints MCP registration one-liners.
title: Onboarding: bare-spendbar wizard, doctor, ownership-fingerprinted uninstall
